books.title: There I Am: The Journey from Hopelessness to Healing
books.author: Ruthie Lindsey
books.description: Ruthie Lindsey's memoir, published by Simon & Schuster, about the years of pain and loss that followed a teenage accident and how she slowly found her way back to joy and wonder. It is the story behind the somatic and self-acceptance work she teaches now, and asks readers to let go of the stories of brokenness they tell about themselves.

flags: Restored under the 12 Nov rule: a memoir of living through chronic pain; her book page (ruthielindsey.com/book) frames healing as inner and emotional and makes no claim to cure or treat a condition.
